text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Splash, splash...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: August 16th...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I'll forever remember this... I won't forget
this
date.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
And neither will the people of this
country. They'll
remember not the 9th,
but the 16th...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On that day... history was rewritten.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Taiki Shuttle takes the win! She's made
her
long-held dream a reality with
today's victory in a
European G1!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
She's become the first Umamusume from
Tracen
Academy to shine at the top of
the world!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Yes! Yes! Yes, yes, yeees!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Thank you all sooo much for your
support!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
People all over the globe watched her
victory, all
with different feelings in their
hearts.

text_block_list.name: Old Female Guide
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, what a splendid race that was.
Well, some
girls are just promised
success, aren't they?

text_block_list.name: Old Female Guide
text_block_list.text:
That's a world far out of reach for us
folk. The
best we can do is watch with
admiration.

text_block_list.name: Young American Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Taiki Shuttle... That was amazing...

text_block_list.name: Young American Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I... could never win like that. I only ever
finish in
second place...

text_block_list.name: Young American Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Even if I tried my best... it'd still be
impossible.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I'm elated for Taiki's success from the
very
bottom of my heart. But... I can't
help but feel a
little melancholic inside.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I'm happy and sad. However...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Everything is perfectly in place now! If I
beat Taiki
Shuttle, I'll be number one in
the world! It's as
simple as that.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Everything is going to plan. Because
now, I'm
finally ready too.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
(You did it, Taiki! You really did it!
But...)
choice_data_list_en: Yeah, you've got what it takes to win!
Yeah, you've got what it takes to win!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to rise even higher than you!

HRAAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Driven by a final burst of determination,
Seeking
the Pearl pushes her speed to a
level that
matches the best racers from
around the world.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With her current leg strength, she'll be
able to
keep up with Taiki Shuttle. The
stage is set.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
All that's left is to see if Taiki Shuttle
enters the
race we expect her to
compete in.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Taiki Shuttle, welcome back! Do you
have any
messages for your fans?

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Now that you're back, are you planning
on taking
a break, or is there a race
you're planning on
entering?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Hold up! You're askin' 'bout what I plan
to do
next?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Well, I still got a lot of fuel left to burn,
so I'll be
runnin' in the Sprinters Stakes
next!

text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text: Oooh!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Taiki Shuttle's live interview from the
airport
confirms that her plans are
exactly as we
predicted.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
It really was. I knew she wouldn't
disappoint.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: After all... Haha. ♪

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I got a message from Pearl after my
victory!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
It said, "Congratulations! Let's meet at
the
Sprinters Stakes next!"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeking the Pearl smiles. A true seeker
never
leaves her destiny in the hands of
another.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She shapes her surroundings by her own
will and
moves steadily toward the fated
challenge ahead.
